$comment: End-of-life register of what Starpi runs on and ships, checked by scripts/eol-check.mjs (npm run eol:check, also in CI). A component whose end of life falls within horizonMonths is a warning (an error with --strict, for releases); a passed date, an incomplete entry, a version that no longer matches .nvmrc, package-lock.json or the workflows, and a production dependency of package.json without an entry are errors. eol: 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'YYYY-MM' (read as the first of the month, so warnings come early) or null when the project publishes no end of life; a date needs a source. kind: runtime, npm (a shipped package), service (an external API) or tooling (build and CI only). Update an entry together with the upgrade it describes.

components.name: Node.js
components.usedFor: build, unit and end-to-end tests, scripts/serve.mjs and CI (.nvmrc); the Vercel Functions
components.note: Maintenance LTS. Move .nvmrc and the workflows to Node.js 24 well before the date.

components.name: Node.js
components.usedFor: supported runtime (package.json engines >=22.13), recommended for new installs

components.name: Python
components.usedFor: tools/library-publisher in the CI test matrix

components.name: Python
components.usedFor: the dependency audit job

components.name: Python
components.usedFor: tools/library-publisher in the CI test matrix, newest Python supported

components.name: PostgreSQL
components.usedFor: CI job for the Supabase migrations and row level security tests (with pgvector)

components.name: Tailwind CSS
components.usedFor: the CSS build (v3 CLI in scripts/build.mjs); nothing of it ships but the generated CSS
components.note: Version 4 is the current major; 3.4 gets maintenance releases only. No end of life is published; plan the move to v4.

components.name: WebLLM
components.usedFor: on-device chat models on the graphics processor (src/js/webgpu)
components.note: No end of life published. Model weights are fetched from the model hub on demand; the SBOM lists the catalog as machine-learning-model components.

components.name: Transformers.js
components.usedFor: on-device models on the processor (WebAssembly worker, src/js/wasm), with a self-hosted ONNX Runtime binary
components.note: No end of life published. Only the web build ships; its Node-only image backend is never bundled (scripts/license-allowlist.json notShipped).

components.name: pdf.js
components.usedFor: PDF text extraction in the ingest worker
components.note: No long-term support line: fixes, security fixes included, ship in the newest release only, so keep it current.

components.name: Anthropic TypeScript SDK
components.usedFor: the Claude adapter of the provider layer, loaded lazily
components.note: Pre-1.0 releases; breaking changes come in minor versions, so upgrade with the adapter tests.

components.name: highlight.js
components.usedFor: syntax highlighting of code blocks, loaded lazily with the rendering extras
components.note: Version 10 is end of life; 11 is the supported major.

components.name: KaTeX
components.usedFor: math rendering to MathML, loaded lazily with the rendering extras
components.note: The package.json override holds this release for every dependent. npm marks 0.18.11 deprecated in favour of 0.19.0; review the move together with the rendering tests.

components.name: Supabase JavaScript client
components.usedFor: the shared knowledge base and the optional account features
components.note: No end of life published for the v2 line.

components.name: DOMPurify
components.usedFor: sanitizing every rendered answer and document
components.note: Security critical: apply its releases promptly.

components.name: marked
components.usedFor: Markdown rendering

components.name: Lucide
components.usedFor: interface icons

components.name: Plus Jakarta Sans (Fontsource)
components.usedFor: the interface font, self-hosted
components.note: Static font files under OFL-1.1, no code.

components.name: NVIDIA API catalog
components.usedFor: hosted models through the site's key pool (api/chat/nvidia.js)
components.note: Models come and go without notice; npm run providers:ping checks the catalog against the live service.

components.name: Google Gemini API
components.usedFor: hosted models with the user's own key, and the live voice socket of the profile public
components.note: Model ids are retired on a published schedule; check the catalog before a release.
